meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 把每个 git worktree（和选中的 PR）当成一个 agent，拉进一个共享 markdown 聊天室分轮对话：各自改了什么、哪里重叠、谁当合并目标、按什么顺序合并。全程只读、不提交不合并，最后由它写汇总并翻成普通人能看懂的话。
howto.when: 当你想比较多条 worktree、分支或 PR 的改动、并要一份统一的合并计划时触发；候选少于两个就不算 standup，它会说明并提议扩大范围后停下。

say.text: 帮我在这几个 worktree 之间开个 standup，看看怎么合并。
say.note: 它会先列出候选让你确认，再分轮推进。

say.text: 把最近 24 小时有改动的分支都拉进 standup。
say.note: 按时间窗挑出有改动的 worktree。

say.text: 把这些开放的 PR 和分支一起放进 standup 对比。
say.note: PR 用 gh 拉取；没有 gh 就只跑 worktree。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a read-only standup: each git worktree (and any PR you pick) is an agent in a shared markdown room, taking rounds on what changed, where branches overlap, the target and merge order. It writes a SUMMATION in plain language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to compare changes across several worktrees, branches or PRs and get one consolidation plan. Fewer than two candidates isn't a standup — it says so and offers to widen.

say_en.text: Run a standup across my worktrees and figure out how to merge them.
say_en.note: It lists candidates for you to confirm.

say_en.text: Pull in branches changed in the last 24 hours.
say_en.note: Filters active worktrees by time window.

say_en.text: Add my open PRs and branches to the standup.
say_en.note: PRs come via gh; without it, worktrees only.
